label: benign
title: Real bank fraud alert: 'call the number on the back of your card'
sources: Hard negative for the Phantom Hacker scenarios: genuine automated fraud alert, no payment or secrecy

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated message from your bank's fraud department about a card purchase at an electronics store.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you made this purchase, press 1. If not, please hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We will never ask for your PIN or ask you to move money over the phone.
